title: The Lost Hero
author: Rick Riordan
summary: A teenage boy wakes on a school bus with no memory, and soon finds he is a demigod, the child of a Greek or Roman god. This opens Heroes of Olympus, a follow-on to Percy Jackson, and introduces new heroes sent on a quest.
readIf: you like Percy Jackson's mix of Greek myth, snark and teen friendship and want a fresh cast.
skipIf: you have not read Percy Jackson, since many references land better after it, or you want a short read.

pairings.reason: The original Percy Jackson book, which sets up the world and the camp that this series builds on.
Another middle-grade adventure with a hidden magical world and siblings facing its dangers.
A grander and more serious adventure with a young hero on a long journey.
